correctness.rationale: A full tree-geodesic proof identifies the only possible shattered triples: equilateral triple branches with a fourth all-positive branch and three distinct singleton extensions. Equal-distance center projections exclude every unequal-arm triple, and four-point supports are impossible by branch geometry. The three disjoint support arms, fourth branch, and disjoint singleton spurs yield |T|>=\(3r+5\), attained by explicit constructions for every r>=2. The radius-one boundary is separately proved. An independent direct-distance code implementation checked all eight traces on exhaustive small trees and 250 seeded random trees, plus all explicit sharp witnesses through r=15: VERIFY_OK 237075. Finite tests are corroboration, not infinite proof.
